d: Not every animal rescue is a walk in the park! When wild creatures turn up in unexpected places, even a routine call can become a risky mission. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, and Neal James take on challenging wildlife encounters involving snakes, turtles, raccoons, mink and other unpredictable animals. With quick reflexes and plenty of hands-on experience, the duo steps in to handle situations that demand courage and careful animal handling.
